title: Make prefix-policy denial a distinct DaoProcessError variant
description: The prefix-authorization gate (project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2) returns rich reasons via DaoManager::authorize_dao_prefixes (PrefixAuthorizationError::Unauthorized(DefaultRoute|ForeignPrefix) / MalformedTarget), but at the process level DaoManager::process_signature_verified_inner maps denial to the pre-existing DaoProcessError::RouteRejected. Introducing DaoProcessError::UnauthorizedPrefix was blocked in scope: lichen-node/src/node.rs (~line 416-425) matches DaoProcessError exhaustively with no wildcard arm, and lichen-node was outside that task's touch scope (rust/lichen-rpl/ only). Fix: add variant UnauthorizedPrefix(UnauthorizedPrefixReason) (or similar) to DaoProcessError in rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs, map the gate denial to it in process_signature_verified_inner, then add the one match arm in lichen-node/src/node.rs mapping it to DaoHandlingOutcome::RouteRejected (or a new outcome variant if desired). Keep gate-level literal tests in rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs green.
